birth.tz_expect: America/Bogota — Colombia observed DST ONLY from May 1992 to Feb 1993, so 1992-11-20 falls INSIDE that era and resolves to UTC-4 (DST), not the usual UTC-5. An engine assuming 'Colombia never has DST' computes her chart an hour off. Get this one and James right and the engine is trustworthy.

arrived.presenting: brilliant on stage, exhausting to herself off it; says people find her 'a lot' and she has spent years dialing herself down to keep them, then resenting the smaller version she becomes
arrived.in_her_words: On stage I'm exactly the right amount. The second the music stops I'm too much again — too loud, too fast, too feelingful. So I shrink, and then I hate her, the small one.

beliefs: my full size drives people away
I have to earn the right to take up space
if they really saw all of me they'd leave
protections: pre-emptively mocking herself before others can
patterns: reads a flicker of a face as rejection
over-gives energy then withdraws to recover
resources: the studio, where her fullness is the point
a company of dancers who love her volume
a body she can always come home to
psyche.origin: the vivid child of a contained household, told to lower her voice at the table; learned her brightness was a disturbance to be managed

self_named: performing so the bigness is allowed
resenting the small version of herself
unaware_of: if they really saw all of me they'd leave

beats.note: arrives strikingly self-aware — names most of her own patterns in the intake, a dense 9-star First Map; the gap to fill is small but pointed
notices the one node she named around but not through: it isn't only being 'too much,' it's not trusting anyone to keep looking
slips into Spanish describing the dinner table — 'baja la voz, Gabi' — the emotional core surfaces in her first language
lets a friend see her mid-meltdown and isn't left; begins separating 'big' from 'unsafe'

engagement.cadence: heavy — writes vividly and often; narrow awareness gap (she names nine of her own stars), so the extraction should mostly confirm and connect rather than reveal

voice: kinetic, vivid, funny, a little breathless; long expressive runs that undercut themselves with a joke; drops into Spanish exactly when the feeling is too big to keep at arm's length in English
